title: Danseso - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Danseso in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Danseso is a fire-element weapon used by Gustave / Verso. It scales with Agility (D), Luck (C).

sections.title: How to Get the Danseso
sections.content:
Location: Old Lumiere - Chromatic Danseuse drop.

Obtained from Old Lumiere - Chromatic Danseuse drop.

sections.title: Is the Danseso Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Agility (D), Luck (C). A dedicated fire pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
